summary: Pipe a readable stream to a writable stream with backpressure and shutdown propagation.

target.notes: Preserve preventClose/preventAbort/preventCancel and AbortSignal behavior; do not model as a naive copy loop.

semantics.normal: returns a promise for completion and locks source/destination while piping
semantics.edge: locked endpoints cause a rejected promise and prevent a second pipe

caveats: Preserve preventClose/preventAbort/preventCancel and AbortSignal behavior; do not model as a naive copy loop.
